comment: Drop variation of unpaid-ship-object-keeper-away-throw. mkobj.c add_to_migration() (2703-2705) reports an unpaid object through impossible(). Seed 6120158's Dlvl 3 has an armor shop (72,14)-(77,18) whose keeper stands at (73,14) inside an open door at (73,13) (port-only scanSeeds() probe over 6120040-6120400 for an armor or weapon shop with an open or empty doorway, fifth hit); ^V 3 lands the debug-mode Valkyrie on a banded mail at (76,16) inside the shop. She picks it up (unpaid), wishes for a hole under herself (objnam.c wizterrainwish() 3573), and #wiztelekinesis (wizcmds.c 515 mhurtle()) flings the keeper north out of the door, so shk.c inhishop() is false. She drops the mail on the hole (do.c dropx() 790 -> dokick.c ship_object() 1639), it falls through, and ship_object() calls stolen_value() for the unpaid object (1700-1702). stolen_value() then finds no billable keeper: shk.c billable() returns FALSE without setting the keeper, and onbill() with no keeper prints "onbill: unpaid obj without shopkeeper?"; the object stays unpaid, so add_to_migration() prints "unpaid object migrating to another level? [banded mail]". Seed, datetime, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session and batch game.
